d: PM Modi Visit Bihar : pradhanmantri narendr modi ne kaha, "itna vishal janasmuday mujhe nahin lagta ki kaimre men kaid ho paega. hamari bahnon ne nirjala vrat rakhkar sarvakalyan ki kamna ki hai aur chhathi maiya ke aashirvad se ham yahan vikas ka parv mana rahe hain. bihar ki is vikas yatra men ham 'sabka sath, sabka vikas' ka mantr lekar aage barh rahe hain. hamne loktantr ko jankalyan ka madhyam banaya hai. endie sarkar ek sal ka karyakal pura kar rahi hai aur is avsar ke lie loktantr ki janni vaishali ko chuna gaya hai. nitish kumar ke netritv men bihar ko sushasan ka bharosa mila aur…
